news.summary: Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton announced on Monday that he would launch an investigation into industry giant UnitedHealth Group for "engaging in deceptive and unlawful practices" that may have denied care to Texans.

news.title: FTC sends price transparency warning letters to 24 large hospital systems
news.summary: Letters sent Monday warn that CMS guidances on price transparency are "a regulatory floor." Hospitals are also subject to the FTC Act's prohibitions on unfair or deceptive marketplace practices, which could apply to incomplete or inaccurate pricing information, the regulator said.

news.summary: The Trump administration on Monday finalized a rule that aims to make the data files mandated under price transparency regulations more usable.

news.title: White House to dispense Part B rebates to more than 20M enrollees
news.summary: On the heels of news that the White House would offer rebates to nearly 1 million people enrolled in Affordable Care Act plans, the Trump administration said Monday that it will pay out $90 rebates to more than 20 million Medicare Part B enrollees.

news.summary: The settlement resolves allegations from 2017 to 2021 that the company submitted “inaccurate and untruthful” diagnoses data to CMS.

news.title: Datavant, ID.me partner on digital identity verification for medical records
news.summary: Datavant has teamed up with ID.me to streamline medical records requests, enabling patients to verify their identities digitally and access records faster.

news.summary: Vaxcyte has seen its stock jump after the biotech’s 31-valent pneumococcal vaccine candidate went head-to-head with Pfizer’s Prevnar 20 and Merck & Co.’s Capvaxive in a phase 3 contest.

news.summary: Click Therapeutics has nabbed FDA approval for its digital therapeutic Motivista, which now becomes the first authorized treatment for negative schizophrenia symptoms.

news.summary: Australia’s CSL is paying $355 million upfront for the rights to Alentis Therapeutics’ phase 2-stage fibrosis drug.

news.title: FDA signs off on first heart valve designed to dynamically expand in children

news.title: ‘We’ve been taking our time’: Buzzy AI biotech Xaira reveals antibody platform, first taste of pipeline
news.summary: When Xaira Therapeutics first debuted in 2024 with a gobsmacking $1 billion in funding, a natural expectation would have been for a flurry of further activity to follow. Instead, the buzzy AI biotech went quiet.

papers.title: Training Numerical Intelligence via Auto-Diagnosis and Skill Discovery
papers.summary: AI agents are becoming increasingly capable of generating scientific code, but generating code is not the same as improving the algorithms behind it. For numerical solvers, execution feedback can expose poor performance, but rarely reveals its underlying cause and how to address it. We introduce Auto-Diagnosis and Skill Discovery (ADSD), a framework that links numerical diagnosis to reusable solver self-improvement. papers.title: Where Does Retrieval-Based Open-Ended Evaluation Fail? Automatic Taxonomy Induction from Long-Form Medical Answer Factuality Verification
papers.summary: Retrieval-based factuality evaluation, where LLM-generated claims are verified against evidence from authoritative medical corpora, has become the dominant paradigm for scalable hallucination detection in high-stakes clinical settings.
